title: Recipe 04: Multi-step modal and wizard
summary: A three-step supplier flow with async options and an approval chain. Each step declares only the controls that exist in that state.
summaryZh: 三步供应商流程，包含异步选项与审批链。每一步只声明该状态真实存在的控件。

guide.title: Expose the current step, not every hidden control
guide.titleZh: 暴露当前步骤，而不是所有隐藏控件
intro: The wizard is conditional rendering. Earlier inputs and buttons stop existing when the step changes.
Industry options arrive asynchronously, so the next action must wait for a real available state.
introZh: 向导使用条件渲染。步骤切换后，旧输入与按钮不再存在。
行业选项异步到达，因此下一步动作必须等待真实可用状态。

steps.title: Declare step-scoped tools
steps.body: The company tool is unavailable once the page moves to contact details.
steps.bodyZh: 页面进入联系人步骤后，公司工具就不可用。

steps.title: Report the visible state
steps.body: The state view tells the agent which step is active and whether options have loaded.
steps.bodyZh: 状态视图告知 Agent 当前步骤与选项是否已加载。

steps.title: Verify before advancing
steps.body: The same function used by the button checks the current step before moving on.
steps.bodyZh: 按钮与助手调用同一个函数，推进前检查当前步骤。

guide.note: Wait for the industry options, fill the company step, continue to contact, then reorder the approval chain before submit.
guide.noteZh: 等待行业选项加载，填写公司步骤，进入联系人，再在提交前调整审批链顺序。
